top_signals.title: Saudi Oil Reroutes Hit Capacity and Security Limits
top_signals.summary: When Iran shut down the Strait of Hormuz, Saudi Arabia quickly redirected its oil flows to the Red Sea. Now, that route has become dangerous because of the Houthi blockade, so Saudi is rerouting to Egypt—and two LNG tankers in the Egyptian port of Damietta just got struck by drones. OPEC’s number-one is running out of options to reroute its oil exports. top_signals.title: AstraZeneca Is Said to Have Explored Bristol Myers Merger
top_signals.summary: AstraZeneca has explored an acquisition of Bristol Myers Squibb, according to people familiar with the matter. It’s unclear if discussions are ongoing or whether they will result in a transaction, the people cautioned. A representative for AstraZeneca declined to comment and Bristol Myers Squibb couldn’t immediately be reached for comment on the talks. Bloomberg's Manuel Baigorri reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
